observations.claim: Circle states that USDC is natively issued on XRPL and supports payments, DeFi and tokenized-asset use cases there.
Qualified businesses can use Circle Mint to convert fiat directly to USDC on XRPL and redeem back to fiat; Circle also supports cross-chain USDC swaps without a third-party bridge.

Circle's global USDC circulation was $70.0B with $71.4B total reserves as of 2026-10-29; Circle's page reports net circulation change of -$0.8B over seven days, -$3.1B over 30 days and -$5.0B over 365 days.

Circle CPN Managed Payments lets PSPs, fintechs, banks and enterprises settle cross-border transactions using USDC while interacting only in fiat; Circle manages minting, burning, orchestration, compliance and blockchain infrastructure.

Circle signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tazapay; closing is expected in 2027 subject to conditions and regulatory approvals. Tazapay was reported to have $25B annualized payment volume, 60+ banking/fintech partners, payout rails in 100+ markets and approximately 60% stablecoin-inclusive volume as of 2026-07-31.
observations.caveat: Agreement is not a completed acquisition; operating metrics are company-reported and forward integration benefits are not realized facts.

observations.claim: Circle announced Arc public mainnet on 2026-09-16 with more than 100 institutional and ecosystem builders and native integration with Circle's platform.
observations.caveat: Arc is a separate Circle-led blockchain network, not XRPL.

observations.claim: XRPLWin displayed Circle USDC supply of 6.02M, 10,806 holders and 17,631 trust lines; it also displayed 1,756 trades and 107,537 USDC 24-hour volume.
observations.snapshot_time: retrieved 2026-11-03; exact metric cutoff not exposed
observations.caveat: Page's last-activity field says 2026-11-01 16:00 UTC, so its 24-hour activity fields may be stale. Do not use as a synchronized live feature.

observations.claim: XRPL.to displayed 857.26M RLUSD on XRPL and 1.71B on Ethereum, 2.57B total, with 33.4% on XRPL and 66.6% on Ethereum; 67,957 XRPL holders and 13,088 Ethereum holders.
XRPL.to's separate RLUSD supply tracker displayed 855.3M RLUSD on XRPL, 67,960 accounts and $3.2M traded over 24 hours.
observations.caveat: Different page and refresh moment than C-OBS8; preserve separately rather than average.

observations.claim: XRPLDashboard at 2026-11-03 17:56:32 UTC displayed XRP at $1.2818 and reported RLUSD XRPL supply growth of $140.6M (+19.75%) over the preceding 24 hours; it also reported AMM TVL down $49K (-0.14%).
observations.caveat: Independent provider snapshot; large one-day supply change requires ledger-level mint/burn reconciliation before use.

observations.claim: Using XRPL.to's 857.26M RLUSD snapshot and XRPLWin's 6.02M USDC snapshot gives an indicative RLUSD-to-USDC supply ratio of about 142:1 on XRPL.
observations.caveat: Cross-provider, asynchronous snapshots; indicative only, not a precise market-share measurement.

observations.claim: Circle scheduled its Q3 2026 results webcast for 2026-11-04 at 08:00 ET.

Ripple and Coinbase announced RLUSD distribution across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail on 2026-10-28, with support across XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as following later.
observations.caveat: A future collateral rollout is not evidence of current collateral acceptance or utilization.

observations.claim: Ripple and SBI Group announced RLUSD availability in Japan through SBI VC Trade after Japanese regulatory approval on 2026-06-24.
observations.caveat: This is a stablecoin distribution relationship; it does not establish incremental XRP purchases.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: More stablecoin activity on XRPL can increase network usage and create some marginal XRP fee/reserve/AMM-path demand.
supporting: USDC and RLUSD are natively available on XRPL.
Stablecoin activity creates ledger transactions and can interact with AMM/DEX liquidity.
disconfirming: No evidence that stablecoin transfers require material XRP inventory beyond account reserves and transaction fees.
The visible USDC/XRP AMM pool depth is modest relative to global USDC supply.
Stablecoin supply growth is not equivalent to net XRP spot purchases.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Stablecoins can displace XRP as the value-transfer asset in some XRPL payment/trading paths even while increasing XRPL usage.
supporting: Circle Mint supports direct fiat-to-USDC and USDC-to-fiat conversion on XRPL.
RLUSD and USDC can settle dollar-denominated value without routing every transfer through XRP.
disconfirming: XRPL auto-bridging may use XRP where the route is economically superior; route-level evidence is needed.
XRP remains the native asset for fees and account reserves.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Circle's CPN Managed Payments, Arc and Tazapay expansion strengthen USDC as a competing cross-border settlement stack outside Ripple/XRPL.
supporting: CPN Managed Payments abstracts digital-asset custody from partners.
Tazapay agreement adds APAC payout rails and 60+ partners, subject to closing.
disconfirming: Circle also supports native USDC on XRPL and cross-chain interoperability.
CPN can coexist with other payment rails; actual corridor-level displacement is not measured.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Ripple RLUSD and Circle USDC are complementary on XRPL but compete for stablecoin liquidity and institutional payment flows.
supporting: Both are native stablecoins on XRPL and can support payments/DeFi.
Circle's USDC provides a neutral multi-chain dollar rail; Ripple's RLUSD is deeply integrated into Ripple's distribution and payment ecosystem.
disconfirming: XRPL snapshots show RLUSD supply far above USDC, but provider timing and methodology differ.
No matched cohort or volume study proves substitution, complementarity or customer segmentation.

competing_hypotheses.thesis: Coinbase distribution of RLUSD may expand stablecoin access and liquidity but does not by itself create XRP demand.
supporting: Coinbase/Ripple announced RLUSD distribution across Coinbase products and multiple chains.
disconfirming: No public evidence in the reviewed announcement establishes actual RLUSD collateral utilization, XRPL balance growth or XRP spot purchases.

key_unknowns: Reconcile XRPLWin USDC supply/volume with XRPL.to and direct issuer-ledger queries using synchronized timestamps.
Reconcile XRPL.to RLUSD supply with XRPLDashboard's reported +$140.6M 24-hour change using issuer mint/burn transaction hashes.
Measure actual XRP/USDC, XRP/RLUSD and USDC/RLUSD order-book depth, AMM depth, slippage and routed volume at synchronized cutoffs.
Determine whether Circle's CPN uses Ripple Payments, XRPL, XRP or RLUSD in any named production corridor; no such link is established by the reviewed CPN releases.
Verify Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral availability and actual utilization separately from the October 28 announcement.
Measure whether stablecoin supply changes correlate with XRP spot demand after controlling for market-wide activity, price, incentives and exchange inventory.
Review Circle Q3 2026 results and transcript after the November 4 webcast.

model_feature_policy.use_for_forecast: Only after provider identity, chain, issuer, token code, timestamp, units and supply-vs-flow semantics are normalized and cross-checked.
model_feature_policy.never_merge: Do not average asynchronous RLUSD/USDC snapshots or treat global USDC circulation as XRPL supply.
model_feature_policy.forecast_boundary: Stablecoin issuance, payment volume, AMM liquidity and XRP spot demand are separate features/targets.
